## Execution tips

- Consider grasping the straight middle section of the vertical handle on the right side of the door, away from its upper and lower joints, leaving room for pad contact and gripper movement.
- Make the gripper opening slightly wider than the handle, and watch the gap between the handle and door panel. Before closing, confirm that both fingers actually enclose the handle; avoid merely overlapping it in the image or grasping the door panel.
- While opening the door, adjust the end-effector position and orientation along its rotation around the hinge, avoiding jamming or slipping from pulling continuously in a straight line.
- Reorient the gripper in open space in front of the handle, leaving swing room for the door and left forearm. Watch the wood-colored stand on the left and beverage bottle on the right to reduce sweeping collisions during approach and opening.
